content:
{
  "root_cause": "The Escape key handler in submenu menus incorrectly closes all submenus of the root menu instead of closing only the current submenu and returning focus to its parent menu item.",
  "repair_strategy": "Modify the Escape key handler in the submenu case (else branch of _handleKeyup in Menubar) to find the toggle that controls this submenu via parentMenu.submenuToggles, close that toggle, and then focus the parent menu item.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "src/menubar.js",
      "sha256": "35aa52673b33aeb4479c15d3f7863ce741e0ce9eee109ee5c70ae02a87a30864",
      "before": "        } else if (key === \"Escape\") {\n          // Hitting Escape:\n          // - Closes submenu.\n          // - Moves focus to parent menubar item.\n          preventEvent(event);\n          this.elements.rootMenu.closeChildren();\n          this.elements.rootMenu.focusCurrentChild();",
      "after": "        } else if (key === \"Escape\") {\n          // Hitting Escape:\n          // - Closes submenu.\n          // - Moves focus to parent menubar item.\n          preventEvent(event);\n          const toggle = this.elements.parentMenu.elements.submenuToggles.find(\n            t => t.elements.controlledMenu === this\n          );\n          if (toggle) {\n            toggle.close();\n          }\n          this.elements.parentMenu.focusCurrentChild();"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Escape will close only the innermost open submenu and move focus to its parent menu item, leaving any outer submenus open as required by the menubar design pattern.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "If the toggle lookup fails (e.g., missing parentMenu or submenuToggles), the submenu will not close, but the guard prevents errors.",
    "For deeply nested submenus, only the immediate parent toggle is closed, which is correct behavior.",
    "No risk of breaking other keyboard shortcuts as the change is isolated to the Escape case."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Verify that pressing Escape when focus is inside a submenu with an open parent submenu results in focus returning to the parent menu item and the parent submenu remaining open (aria-expanded true).",
    "Verify that Escape works when only one submenu is open: it closes that submenu and returns focus to the corresponding menubar item.",
    "Ensure that Escape does not cause unexpected focus loss or closure of unrelated UI elements.",
    "Confirm that the fix does not regress the existing Escape behavior for top-level menubar (closing open submenus or controller)."
  ]
}
